claim: Locally available cochain-compatibility errors and distributed relational memory produce identity-preserving organizational-regime recovery after bounded intervention, beyond passive, filtering, topology, trivial-attractor, signal-blind, parameter-matched, and ablation controls.

final_evaluation_partition.access_policy: The runner may access this partition only after mechanism tests, leakage tests, contract checks, calibration, and validation complete without contract modification.

identity_criteria.primary: agreement between current edge-difference signs and stored one-bit relational orientations
identity_criteria.secondary: rank correlation of current and pre-intervention node order
identity_criteria.global_offset: unidentified gauge and excluded from identity

initial_condition_generation: Seeded low-frequency scalar fields on an 8x8 periodic grid, standardized to zero mean and unit variance before relational memory is encoded.
invalidation_conditions: mechanism object contains a reference state, future trajectory, recovery score, final label, or evaluation classification
final partition is used in parameter or threshold selection
relation memory plus metadata directly serializes the full node state rather than local edge relations
correction direction uses distance to the hidden reference state
any mandatory control fails its mechanism assertion
contract or thresholds change after final evaluation begins

available_information: current endpoint state on each local edge
locally stored one-bit pre-intervention edge orientation
mechanism.equation: x_(t+1) = x_t + eta * D^T [availability * s * max(0, margin - s * D x_t)] / max_degree
mechanism.name: redundant_local_cochain_constraint_feedback

observable_information: Only current local edge inequality violations against distributed one-bit orientation memory; no edge magnitudes, future, or full-state checkpoint.
parameter_selection_policy: Choose the eta/tolerance pair with highest calibration-only median organizational recovery minus 0.02 times median corrective cost; ties resolve by lower eta then lower tolerance. Validation cannot change parameters.
perturbation_magnitude_definition: RMS of a zero-mean perturbation relative to the unit-variance initial field.
perturbation_timing: One intervention at t=0 after local relation memory is encoded.
stopping_condition: Execute the frozen calibration, validation, and final partitions once. Any mechanism, grid, threshold-formula, split, or control change requires EL-R3-RT-03.

system_family.graph: 8x8 periodic square grid with horizontal, vertical, and two diagonal local relation edges
system_family.stored_memory: one-bit signs of oriented local edge differences only; magnitudes and node values are not stored

threshold_derivation.control_margin_min: max(0.05, 0.5 * calibration median target-vs-best-admissible-control gain margin)
threshold_derivation.recovery_gain_min: max(0.10, 0.5 * calibration target median recovery gain)

uncertainty_method: Run-level stratified bootstrap over final seed x perturbation-family x magnitude rows; resamples estimate uncertainty only.
